title: Most Nonprofits Skip This Critical Fundraising Step
actionable_recommendations: Stop chasing random fundraising trends and follow a clear process.
Perform groundwork before launching any fundraising campaign.
Conduct a fundraising audit and a simple SWAT analysis.
Identify your true capacity and plan accordingly.
claims_requiring_current_verification: Students have raised between $20K–$100K in about 90 days based on the described strategies.
intended_organization_or_user: Nonprofits looking to improve their fundraising strategies.
major_ideas: The importance of groundwork before a fundraising campaign.
Understanding the competitive landscape of nonprofit fundraising.
Identifying potential donors and aligning with their values and interests.
Assessing personal and organizational capacity for fundraising.
prerequisites: An understanding of the competitive landscape in nonprofit fundraising.
Knowledge of donor demographics and values.
An assessment of organizational capacity for executing fundraising plans.
proposed_workflow: Review similar nonprofits and their fundraising efforts.
Research demographics and industries in your region.
Create donor personas using both qualitative and quantitative data.
Plan fundraising campaigns based on realistic capacity and unique organizational strengths.
tools_templates_resources: AI donor persona tools for demographic and market data analysis.
SWAT analysis template for evaluating fundraising strengths and weaknesses.
General research tools to analyze donor demographics.
